decisions.reason: The window's close-up promises dark when the count is lost and the room contradicted it; the count now goes on the move it is lost, and the fresh draw says only that the window has woken.

Three runs reached the dog long before the collar and read one snap four times; grading what is offered and pointing up the stair toward the kennel is Zork's joke made legible, with Zork's snap kept for anything else.

A room whose rule is that every passage leads somewhere should not answer 'up' with the parser; 'up' and 'down' while it spins, and the passages taken or entered by name, are answered in the narrator's voice. 'take the passage that climbs' stays the parser's: 'that climbs' is not a relative phrase the language can read (friction 86).

Zork's draw stays, as the brief wants; the pointer to the works becomes concrete by sound, under the floor and past the well, in the first-throw line and the Circular Room. The request to put the narrator's invitation ahead of Zork's 'Eight identical passages' is declined within the acceptance: Zork's text stays whole and first in every room.

As round 6 did for the cakes, the tell comes before the cost and the cost stays Zork's: the lizard's close-up says what it is hungry for, and the line for a thing eaten says it was not what it wanted, so a visitor who fed it the fuse knows the fuse is lost.

Intent says the first call carries the hook and one of three spells; seed 6's ordinary roll in the barrow spent the debut on Fear with no hook. His first appearance is now his first call wherever it falls, with a seeded test on seed 6.

A plain tell stops at the room's occupants and a visitor in the bucket, basket or cage is the occupant of a thing in the room; every line of the Wizard's turn is now told to the visitor who told him where they were (friction 85).

The princess is the only route to the gold key and the Wizard's door; a visitor two moves behind her read 'Dragon Room' and nothing else. Her footprints are on every room she has passed, in BRIEF as in full, until she has ridden off.
A warning read four times without consequence teaches that it is safe; it now says what it warns of, in full once and in short after: another blow before he cools is the last, and a walk cools him.
The end line names what goes where the room showed something, the illusion's words are answered in voice for two commands after, and the ZORK I copy answers to 'zork i'.

'The teapot is empty' and 'the fords are where it comes up' are already the world's answers to this intent elsewhere; 'water' typed where there is none now gets them too, by a stand-in the teapot keeps (friction 87).

A fidelity slip, but not one the world can fix: articles are dropped by the parser where a value is expected, quotation marks are not, so the symbol role reads '"a' and arrives unbound, and no phrase can be written with a quotation mark in it. Logged as friction 83 for Sprout, not worked around.
Round 5's hold was set in :moved, which is queued behind the clock, so it had never held; the clock now reads the arrival itself off the room the command began in (friction 84).

The two walls the point names, the dog and the princess's key, are answered by P2 and P8, and the turn sinks by P1 and P4; that is the world's share. Filtering accidental same-line repeats from the repetition metric is the studio's tooling, not the world's, and is not changed here.

changes.what: A wrong step from a base zeroes the count and broadcasts it on that move, so the landing room's window reads dark; the fresh draw into a corner says only that the window has woken. New seeded test on seed 5.

Cerberus grades what is offered: food is not what it is hungry for, the pearl necklace gets a sniff and a scratch at the bare neck as the right idea and the wrong size, anything else Zork's snap; its close-up has a head lift up the stair toward the quarry and the leaning stone with the F.

'Up' and 'down' in the spinning Carousel are answered by the visitor's no_way passage in the narrator's voice; the passages take 'climbing', 'one' and the compass adjectives, and 'take'/'enter'/'go through' a passage says a way is walked into.

The first-throw line says where the works are by the sound, under the floor and toward the climbing passage, past the well; the Circular Room says the whirring comes from above the shaft, past the top of it. Every test that reads those lines updated.

The lizard head's close-up (now a named passage, over the 600-character cap, friction 88) says what it is hungry for and that anything else is swallowed out of habit and not given back; the line for a thing eaten says it was not what the lizard wanted and it is as hungry as before.
The Wizard's first appearance is his first call wherever it falls, the barrow included: one of Feeble, Fumble and Fantasize, with the hook. Seeded test reproducing seed 6's early roll.
Every line of the Wizard's turn is 'tell from', addressed to the visitor who told him where they were, so a visitor in the bucket, the basket or the cage reads his appearance, wave and word.
The princess's stand-in in every room she has passed lists her footprints and the way they lead, in BRIEF as in full, until she has ridden off.

The dragon's 'very careful now' warning says, in full the first time and in brackets after, that another blow before he has had a move to cool is the last and that walking off cools him; blows route through a :dragon_blow message that tracks whether the warning has been shown.

Fantasize's end line names what vanishes where this room showed something; the illusion fades over two commands, answering a reach for it with the word having worn off before the parser has it back; the ZORK I copy answers to 'zork i'.

A NoWater stand-in kept inside the teapot, Pourable but not a Thing so nothing lists or counts it, in reach while the pot is empty and the room is not Watery, answering every verb with where the water is; Pourable made a bare marker kind.

The garden clock rolls nothing on the move a visitor arrives at the north end, read off :last_room in the visitor's after command rather than a hold set in the queued :moved; tests that expected the unicorn to bound away on arrival now expect it listed.

intent.md records each accepted change under its mechanism; friction.md gains entries 83 to 88 (the quoted riddle answer, after command ahead of the queued :moved, plain tell and nested places, 'up' with eight ways out, a noun for what is not there, the 600-character text cap); README lists revision8 among the per-round tests.
